warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

The fifth door panel (PVC, 0.80/0.70 x 2.05, count 2) has an empty mark bubble on this sheet. A-03 tags both bathroom doors ป5 and this is the only PVC door type with count 2, so it is recorded as ป5 with lower confidence and a flag.

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Heights: 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง for every door and window head.
น3 prints sill 0.85 + window 1.10 against an overall 2.05 (adds to 1.95) — kept the printed values, flagged.
